name: shoots_minimal
vibe: minimal soft domestic: flowers, interiors, linen and denim
_comment: Board kholthaus8/shoots (pin.it/5sIuOnToR). Longer cut, no photo in more than one version: the 35 usable pins are split 12/12/11. 40 BPM = 1.5 s per photo, ends on a bar line. No borders. Crops (junk overlay only): stone-house-hydrangeas bottom 120 px, sunburst-leaves bottom 90 px. Left out: pin 22 (shopping graphic with text and affiliate tag). The 5 soft pins (<500 px side or shown enlarged) are used once each: farmhouse patio, uno on a blanket, horses, candlelit window room, shoulder shadows. Version 2: warm stone grey, hard cuts.
